caption: The drawing depicts two vertical, cylindrical wooden posts with finials at the top, labeled "HEAD" and "FOOT" at the bottom. Both posts have a predominantly reddish-brown hue, indicating a polished wood surface with highlights and shading to suggest dimensionality. The "HEAD" post on the left features an ornate, carved top with a bulbous, acorn-shaped finial and a segment of intricate, lattice-like, diamond patterns beneath the finial, followed by a rounded section with a leaf motif and a turned, ridged base. Below these carved sections is a rectangular block with a mortise joint cut into its face. The "FOOT" post on the right is simpler, with a pointed, smaller acorn-shaped finial, a smooth cylindrical shaft, and a turned ring around the post near the middle. There is a round peg or knob protruding from one side, and the base of this post is also turned and ribbed. The posts are shown on a plain cream background with shadows beneath, signed "Will Jennings" in the lower center.
title: Bed Posts
